title: Virtual Compute: collection suspension grace period
content:
## Meaning — collection suspension grace period

Virtual Compute collection suspension grace period: Calendar days after invoice maturity before collection suspension; integer.

## Tier values — collection suspension grace period

Northbridge Virtual Compute 2 vCPU — collection suspension grace period: 15.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 4 vCPU — collection suspension grace period: 15.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 8 vCPU — collection suspension grace period: 15.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 16 vCPU — collection suspension grace period: 15.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 32 vCPU — collection suspension grace period: 15.

Northbridge Virtual Compute 64 vCPU — collection suspension grace period: 15.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for collection suspension grace period?**

Every listed Virtual Compute tier has collection suspension grace period of 15.
